content: BIBREF9, BIBREF54, BIBREF11, BIBREF10 conduct some node classification experiments on citation networks, where nodes are scientific papers, i.e., textual data. However, text is only used to derive node feature vectors. The external graph structure, which plays a central role in determining node labels, is completely unrelated to text.
